paras: Peters' gecko (Gonatodes petersi) is a species of lizard in the family Sphaerodactylidae. The species is endemic to Venezuela.
The specific name, petersi, is in honor of American herpetologist James A. Peters.
G. petersi is found on the eastern slopes of the Sierra de Perijá in Zulia state, Venezuela.
The natural habitat of G. petersi is forest at altitudes of 230–1,130 m (750–3,710 ft).
